

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# Helper function to render child Rmds as inline text
render_child <- function(file) {
  text <- knitr::knit_child(file, quiet = TRUE)
  gsub("\n", " ", text) # Remove unwanted newlines
}
```

`r paste0(render_child("bulletin-monthly_leadtext-temp_de.Rmd"), " ", render_child("bulletin-monthly_leadtext-precip_de.Rmd"), " ", render_child("bulletin-monthly_leadtext-sun_de.Rmd"))`
